articles.title: Bluefin to shut down perps, refocus on spot trading and tokenized RWAs
articles.description: Bluefin will close its perps platform on Dec. 4, exiting a shrinking Sui market where it once handled over $500 million in daily trades.

articles.title: SpaceX shares jump 4% amid tech rally and after Musk says he will expand on Trump Account share donations
articles.description: SpaceX shares jumped in premarket trading after Elon Musk said on X that he would donate shares to American children every year.

articles.title: Ethereum Sets December 15 Date for Delayed Glamsterdam Testnet Upgrade
articles.description: Core developers will ship Glamsterdam's contested gas changes unaltered, after security concerns halted the Hoodi fork in October.

articles.title: Chinese chip stocks notch biggest ever one-day gains as Beijing signals broader market support
articles.description: Chinese stocks rebounded sharply after a rare intraday state media readout cheered investors as top policymakers pledged market liquidity support.

articles.title: Defense giant Rheinmetall embraces ‘new normal’ of caution after military contract setback; stock rises
articles.description: The German arms maker vows a "more prudent approch" to forecast sales of tanks and ammunition.

articles.title: Tether can freeze stolen crypto in minutes. Getting it back can take years.

articles.title: Bitcoin tops $61,000 as Nasdaq futures extend Wednesday’s rebound

articles.title: ESMA to overhaul EU’s MiCA crypto register in 2027
articles.description: ESMA’s new MiCA register will replace manual reporting and introduce automated data checks and a version history for crypto white papers.

articles.title: Monero suffers biggest single-day slide in over 5 months. Here’s why

articles.title: New York AG secures $1.37B court judgment against NovaTech founders

articles.title: Tech German software major SAP is reportedly weighing cutting at least 10,000 jobs in AI push
articles.description: SAP is weighing cuts of at least 10,000 jobs as it reshapes its software business around AI, Bloomberg reported.

articles.title: Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos set to lead European Central Bank
articles.description: De Cos will lead the ECB into a period of political uncertainty and choppy growth, after winning the backing needed to succeed Christine Lagarde next year.

articles.title: China’s factories are growing profits again, but the AI boom is picking the winners

articles.title: Fast cars, big money: Why sportswear races into Formula 1 as sponsorship spending soars 75%
articles.description: Nike, Adidas and Puma are betting big on Formula 1 as the sport's cultural influence grows and younger audiences fuel its appeal.

articles.title: Japan’s crypto security group taps SEAL to speed up hack response
articles.description: The partnership comes weeks after a third-party data breach exposed hundreds of thousands of customer email addresses belonging to two Japanese crypto exchanges.

articles.title: Ripple's lending plan moves closer to tapping XRP Ledger's $800 million in stablecoins
articles.description: The vaults that would hold lenders' money are on track to switch on Dec. 9. The loan system that draws from them still needs one more validator to start its own two-week clock.

articles.description: Glamsterdam’s Hoodi upgrade was delayed in October after concerns that changes to gas pricing could break some existing smart contracts.

articles.title: Binance says customer withdrawals are fully restored, four weeks after the $6.3 billion hack
articles.description: Binance says it has fully lifted withdrawal suspensions imposed after October’s $6.3 billion hack, though a small number of networks remain paused for unrelated maintenance.
